releaseNotes: Permanent Route Batch Geotag Persistence: Fixed location batch assignment so assigned batches persist across cloud syncs, app updates, and server restarts without loss
Offline Geotag Sync Buffer: Locations marked offline are now reliably backed up to device storage and auto-synchronized to the server as soon as connection is restored
Optional Address Validation: Flexible location geotagging ensuring clinic and store coordinates save immediately without requiring manual address inputs
